git_bin_path.description: Git binary path to use for git clone

helm_bin_path.description: If provided it will be used instead for installing Helm binary

kube_apiserver.description: Address and the port for the Kubernetes API server

kube_as_group.description: Group to impersonate for the operation, this flag can be repeated to specify multiple groups

kube_as_user.description: Username to impersonate for the operation

kube_ca_file.description: Certificate authority file for the Kubernetes API server connection

kube_context.description: Name of the kubeconfig context to use

kube_insecure_skip_tls_verify.description: If true, the Kubernetes API server's certificate will not be checked for validity. This will make your HTTPS connections insecure

kube_tls_server_name.description: Server name to use for Kubernetes API server certificate validation. If it is not provided, the hostname used to contact the server is used

api_version.description: ExecCredential API version passed via KUBERNETES_EXEC_INFO

args.description: Arguments to pass to the exec command

command.description: Command to execute for retrieving the Kubernetes token

env.description: Environment variables to pass to the exec command

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum number of seconds to wait for the exec command before failing

block.description: Exec-based authentication configuration (e.g., EKS, AKS, GKE). Supports raw token output and JSON token fields like status.token/accessToken/access_token

atomic.description: Whether to roll back the Helm chart installation if it fails

chart_path.description: The relative path to the Helm chart

chart_repository.description: URL of the chart repository containing the Helm chart, Helm cli is used for downloading

chart_url.description: URL to the Helm chart, it supports advanced parameters, archives and variety of protocols: http::, file::, s3::, gcs::, hg::

chart_version.description: The version of the Helm chart to install

create_namespace.description: Whether to create the Kubernetes namespace if it does not exist

custom_args.description: Additional arguments to pass to the Helm CLI

debug.description: Enable debug mode for the Helm CLI

git_reference.description: Reference (e.g. branch, tag, commit hash) to checkout in the Git repository

git_repository.description: URL of the git repository containing the Helm chart, git cli is used for downloading)

max_retries.description: The maximum number of retry attempts for downloading remote resources (default is 0, no retries).

namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace where the Helm chart will be installed

post_renderer_url.description: URL of the post-renderer script to download and use

release_chart_name.description: The name of the installed Helm chart

release_chart_version.description: The version of the installed Helm chart

release_revision.description: The revision of the installed Helm release

release_status.description: The current status of the installed Helm release

release_values.description: The values passed to the Helm chart at installation time

retry_delay.description: The fixed delay duration between retry attempts for downloading remote resources (e.g., '2s').

timeout.description: The maximum time to wait for the Helm chart installation to complete

values.description: A YAML string representing the values to be passed to the Helm chart

values_files.description: A list of the values file names or URLs to be passed to the Helm chart

wait.description: Whether to wait for the Helm chart installation to complete
